items.q: The show included the orchestras of Bernard Hilda and Maurice Toubas. They were both known as high society orchestras in Europe

ctx.x: was the ideal place to conceal the stuff for a special reason. I said before that this hotel was a second rate one, although my room was nice for that type of hotel. The bed was clean and sheets were changed every week. The maid cleaned everywhre except under the bed and on top of the cabinets, so when I looked on top of the one in my room, there was dust thick enough to plant potatoes. I took my boxes and the package, put them on top of the cabinet and covered them with dust. Then I breathed a sigh of relief and…

The Edouard's band, Don Byas and myself were still doing concerts and in April, we went to Knokke for three days at the casino with a big show. This was the 16th, 17th and 18th. The show included the orchestras of Bernard Hilda and Maurice Toubas. They were both known as high society orchestras in Europe, and we took care of the jazz department. Other acts engaged were the Nicholas Brothers - dance team- Rosario and Antonio, famous Spanish couple, Borrah Minevitch's Harmonica Vagabonds, the well known Bluebell…

The war had not changed naything in Kokke since I was there the summer of 1938. Everything went well until the last night when Don Byas went into one of his acts after the last show. Of course, we all had quite a few drinks and were feeling no pains. I had already left the casino when thiks incident happened, but I was told by one of the musicians that Don was high and in the process of changing his clothes, he decided to chase one of the Bluebell girls that had passed his lodge when the door was open.
